allelePhenotypes.phenotype: Patients with the rs193922748 CC genotype may have a decreased, but not absent, risk for malignant hyperthermia based on this variant when treated with volatile anesthetics (desflurane, enflurane, halothane, isoflurane, methoxyflurane, sevoflurane) and/or succinylcholine as compared to patients with the CT or TT genotype. Other genetic or clinical factors may also influence the risk for malignant hyperthermia.

Patients with the rs193922748 CT genotype may develop malignant hyperthermia when treated with volatile anesthetics (desflurane, enflurane, halothane, isoflurane, methoxyflurane, sevoflurane) and/or succinylcholine as compared to patients with the CC genotype. Other genetic or clinical factors may also influence the risk for malignant hyperthermia.

Patients with the rs193922748 TT genotype may develop malignant hyperthermia when treated with volatile anesthetics (desflurane, enflurane, halothane, isoflurane, methoxyflurane, sevoflurane) and/or succinylcholine as compared to patients with the CC genotype. Other genetic or clinical factors may also influence the risk for malignant hyperthermia.
